content.title: StatsAI football forecast calibration report — [11. 2026]
content.abstract: StatsAI football forecast calibration report — [11. 2026] Monthly evaluation of pre-match football probability estimates published by StatsAI (statsai.bet), compared with bookmaker odds converted to probabilities with the margin removed, on the same matches. Contents- Aggregated figures per market (1X2, total goals 2.5, both teams to score) and per competition tier: number of matches, Brier score, log loss, calibration bins and accuracy, for the model and for the no-vig odds.- Every estimate was stored before kick-off and was not changed afterwards. No match is removed after the result is know
